text: The purpose of this staff report is to report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a Sidewalk Café permit located at 3020 Danforth Avenue, Thyra Avenue flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed Sidewalk Cafe permit located at 3020 Danforth Avenue, Thyra Avenue flankage.
